rules.team_results: Final scores from all closed regular-season games; summary fallback if raw missing.
rules.team_statistics: Sum original team statistics, not sums of player rows.
rules.player_key: season_id + player_id + team_id; preserve team stints and combine source roles.
rules.games_with_records: Number of games containing a player record; not official appearances.
rules.missing_values: Never replace missing/invalid values with zero. Totals sum observed valid values only; null if none.
rules.missing_game_players: Flag every observed player of the affected teams; actual participation is unknown. Unobserved players cannot be listed.
rules.innings_pitched: Baseball n.1/n.2 notation converted to outs, summed, then emitted as n.r string; original raw files retained.
rules.strikeouts: Ambiguous original field preserved; not exposed as pitcher_strikeouts.
rules.rates: Derived from observed counts only, not official season rates; null for incomplete required fields or zero denominator.
rules.quality: Source inconsistencies are reported without correction; complete coverage does not guarantee source accuracy.
